description: Monitor evaluated recently; AWS returned no anomalies for the window.
speech: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection reported no anomalies between October 8 and October 15. That doesn't guarantee spending is normal: detection covers only what your monitors watch, and it isn't real-time. AWS last evaluated your costs on October 14.

report.currency_basis: documented_not_returned: the Cost Anomaly Detection API returns impact amounts without a currency field; AWS's Impact documentation describes them as dollar values
